title: Query count under a change of available set
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\Omega$ and $\alpha$ be types, and let $A,B\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be equal sets. For any finite decision tree $T$ with available-coordinate set $A$ and any input $x:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\Omega$, regarding $T$ as a tree with available set $B$ leaves its query count on $x$ unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A finite decision tree with available-coordinate set $A$
